description: Lists barbers, stylists, nail techs and estheticians on Mane who have chosen to be found through AI assistants. Returns each operator’s slug, operator_id, display name, business name, city, profession and booking page URL. Operators who have not opted in are never returned. Optional filters match part of the city or profession, case-insensitive.

city.description: Optional part of a city name, for example "Royal Palm".

profession.description: Optional part of a profession, for example "barber" or "esthetician".

name: search_operators
title: Search Mane operators
